RollingArtist.description: Randomly draws artists from an artist CSV, assigns random weights, and outputs a weighted prompt plus a structured JSON result.

artist_count.name: Artist Count
artist_count.tooltip: Number of artists generated per run (1-10). With Mode = auto, setting this to 1 while Force Include is empty enters Exact mode: it enumerates (artist, weight) combinations without repetition and returns ALL_COMBINATIONS_TESTED once every combination has been used. To draw a single artist without exhausting, set Mode = random.

artist_top_ratio.name: Top Pool Ratio
artist_top_ratio.tooltip: Top pool ratio (0.01-1.0): the first ceil(total × ratio) rows of the CSV (at least 1) form the Top pool. Artists listed earlier in the file usually have more works.

artist_top_count.name: Top Pick Count
artist_top_count.tooltip: How many Top-pool artists are drawn per run at minimum (1-10). Only used when Top Priority is enabled and the Top pool is not empty.

weight_min.name: Min Weight
weight_min.tooltip: Lower bound of a single artist weight (step 0.1). Swapped automatically if it is above the upper bound; negative values are clamped to 0.

weight_max.name: Max Weight
weight_max.tooltip: Upper bound of a single artist weight (step 0.1). Every weight stays between the lower and upper bound.

weight_total.name: Weight Total
weight_total.tooltip: Sum of all weights (step 0.5), distributed exactly; clamped to the feasible range when out of bounds. Not used in Exact mode, where weights are enumerated on a 0.1 grid instead.

weight_curve.name: Weight Curve
weight_curve.tooltip: Controls who gets more weight only; bounds and total are unaffected. flat = even (current behaviour, similar weights, styles blend evenly); dominant = one random artist clearly dominates; ramp = descending ladder over a random order. Not used in Exact mode.

artists_prefix.name: artist: Prefix
artists_prefix.tooltip: When on, outputs artist:name (for example (artist:xxx:0.8)); when off, outputs the plain name.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed. The same seed with the same settings is reproducible; dedup mode and max attempts change the actual sampling sequence.

use_top_priority.name: Top Priority
use_top_priority.tooltip: When on, draws from the Top pool first and always includes Top Pick Count Top artists; when off, samples uniformly from the whole CSV.

sort_by_weight.name: Sort by Weight
sort_by_weight.tooltip: When on, reorders the artists in the prompt by weight (descending). The order affects the full_prompt dedup key.

exclude_artists.name: Exclude Artists
exclude_artists.tooltip: Artist names to exclude, comma separated (for example a,b,c). Excluded names never appear in the result.

force_include.name: Force Include
force_include.tooltip: Artist names that must appear, comma separated. Takes priority over Exclude Artists; when their count reaches Artist Count the result is drawn from this list.

mode.name: Mode
mode.tooltip: Generation mode. auto = previous behaviour (Artist Count = 1 with an empty Force Include enters Exact mode); random = never exhaust; exact = force Exact mode (requires Artist Count = 1 and an empty Force Include, otherwise the node errors out). Dedup mode and Weight Total do not apply in Exact mode.

dedup_mode.name: Dedup Mode
dedup_mode.tooltip: Dedup key: none = record only, no duplicate check; full_prompt = same artist order and weights; artist_set = same artist set (order and weights ignored); artist_list = same sorted names (weights ignored). Exact mode always uses full_prompt.

max_attempts.name: Max Attempts
max_attempts.tooltip: Maximum retries in dedup mode (1-100). If every retry hits an already-tested combination, the last result is accepted and a WARNING is logged.

custom_csv_path.name: Custom CSV Path
custom_csv_path.tooltip: Path to a custom artist CSV; leave empty to use danbooru_art_001.csv in the node directory.

tested_db_path.name: Records DB Path
tested_db_path.tooltip: Path of the SQLite records database; leave empty to use rollingartist.sqlite in the node directory. Both tested records and the Exact-mode combination pool live here, so changing the path resets dedup progress. The database at the default path is cleared on every startup; set an explicit path to keep it across sessions.

1.name: Artists JSON
1.tooltip: Structured result JSON (artists / weights / top flag / status).

2.name: Tested Count
2.tooltip: Number of combinations recorded in the current database.

3.name: Remaining Count
3.tooltip: Combinations left in the pool in Exact mode; always 0 outside Exact mode (including when a huge universe falls back to random sampling).

RollingCharacter.description: Randomly draws characters from a character CSV and outputs one line per character as "character tag, copyright tag, core_tags" (newline separated), plus a structured JSON result and the tested count.

character_count.name: Character Count
character_count.tooltip: Number of characters generated per run (1-10), one output line each. Characters are single tags, so there is no exhaustion mode.

character_top_ratio.name: Top Pool Ratio
character_top_ratio.tooltip: Top pool ratio (0.01-1.0): the first ceil(candidates × ratio) rows of the CSV (at least 1) form the Top pool; earlier rows have more works. Candidates are the characters left after Copyright Filter.

character_top_count.name: Top Pick Count
character_top_count.tooltip: How many Top-pool characters are drawn per run at minimum (1-10). Only used when Top Priority is enabled and the Top pool is not empty.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed. The same seed with the same settings is reproducible; dedup mode and max attempts change the actual sampling sequence.

use_top_priority.name: Top Priority
use_top_priority.tooltip: When on, draws from the Top pool first and always includes Top Pick Count Top characters; when off, samples uniformly from all candidates.

exclude_characters.name: Exclude Characters
exclude_characters.tooltip: Character names to exclude, comma separated. Excluded names never appear in the result.

force_include.name: Force Include
force_include.tooltip: Character names that must appear, comma separated. Takes priority over Exclude Characters; when their count reaches Character Count the result is drawn from this list. Names that are not in the CSV still work, but carry no copyright or appearance tags.

copyright_filter.name: Copyright Filter
copyright_filter.tooltip: Only draw characters from these works, comma separated (for example touhou,vocaloid); empty means no limit. Accepts both the raw copyright form fate_(series) and the escaped trigger form fate_\(series\), case-insensitively. Errors out when nothing is left after filtering.

include_core_tags.name: Include Appearance Tags
include_core_tags.tooltip: Whether to append each character's fixed appearance tags (core_tags) to its line. On: "character tag, copyright tag, core_tags"; off: "character tag, copyright tag".

dedup_mode.name: Dedup Mode
dedup_mode.tooltip: Dedup key: none = record only; full_prompt = same character order and weights; artist_set = same character set (order and weights ignored); artist_list = same sorted names (weights ignored).

max_attempts.name: Max Attempts
max_attempts.tooltip: Maximum retries in dedup mode (1-100). If every retry hits an already-tested combination, the last result is accepted and a WARNING is logged.

custom_csv_path.name: Custom CSV Path
custom_csv_path.tooltip: Path to a custom character CSV; leave empty for danbooru_character_001.csv in the node directory.

tested_db_path.name: Records DB Path
tested_db_path.tooltip: Path of the SQLite records database; leave empty for rollingcharacter.sqlite in the node directory (separate from the artist node). Changing the path resets dedup progress.

0.name: Character List
0.tooltip: One line per character in the form "character tag, copyright tag, core_tags", with no weights. With "Include Appearance Tags" turned off it becomes "character tag, copyright tag".

1.name: Characters JSON
1.tooltip: Structured result JSON (character / copyright / top flag / count / appearance tags).

2.name: Tested Count
2.tooltip: Number of character combinations recorded in the current database.
